_comment: Catalogue for the WrongnessDirector (S-07). 'behaviours' = the reusable library to implement once; 'instances' = concrete wrongs. An instance id IS the wrong_id: put it on the prop in data/world/<space>.json (props[].wrong_id) and call Unreality.wrongs(id, bias). 'tier' 1-3 = how overt (1 barely noticeable, 3 plainly wrong); schedule so tier 1 shows from band 1, tier 2 from band 2, tier 3 from band 3+. 'acts' = [first, last] act where it may appear. 'scripted' = driven by the story beat, not by threshold. RULES: effects change only under the behaviour's 'observed' rule (never in plain view unless 'always'); moving effects multiply Unreality.motion_scale() and have the Reduced Motion fallback; no strobing; add no lore (CANON). See docs/WRONGNESS.md.

lean.summary: A prop tilts a few degrees.
lean.reduced_motion: static tilt applied while unseen (no tween)

swap.summary: An object is replaced by a near-identical wrong variant (other label, other weapon, other picture).

repeat.summary: The same thing appears again (same painting/hill/jar label) where a different one should be.

appear.summary: A thing that was not there is there (a chandelier, a figure, a painting from another wing).

move_unseen.summary: An object or character is somewhere else when you look back (trees closer, Frank's seat, a switch on another wall).
move_unseen.reduced_motion: same: relocation only ever happens while unseen

door_state.summary: A door is open/ajar/closed against expectation.

door_count.summary: The number of doors in a run changes.

door_dest.summary: A known door leads somewhere else (kitchen back-stair opens upstairs).

count_wrong.summary: A countable thing has the wrong number (twelve nests, seven pillows, windows, seats, pans).
count_wrong.reduced_motion: same: re-counted only after a look-away

corridor_stretch.summary: A walked route is longer/taller on return (hall, stair, passage, path).
corridor_stretch.reduced_motion: slow lerp scaled by motion_scale; Reduced Motion = change only across a fade/door

step_count.summary: One step too many/few going up vs down.

route_loop.summary: A route that should progress repeats or does not add up (left-right-left, the endless fork).

proportion.summary: A room/prop is a little larger/smaller/taller than before (door too tall, bed too wide, walls turn round).

eyes_follow.summary: Painted or sculpted eyes track the player.
eyes_follow.reduced_motion: eyes fixed on player, no tracking motion

turn_to_face.summary: Statues/suits/dummies/birds end up facing the player's doorway.

stillness.summary: Characters too still: no blink, hands frozen, a smile held too long.

lag.summary: A character's reaction/lip movement is a half-beat late.
lag.reduced_motion: reduce to a fixed small delay

face_morph.summary: Face drifts toward age/relative/wrongness (Mary Sue ages, Elsa's face pulled long, Frank toward Clement).
face_morph.reduced_motion: morph only across blinks/cuts, no tween

light_misbehave.summary: A light is wrong: flicker, hum, cold lamp, warm moon, light with no source, shadows lag.
light_misbehave.reduced_motion: no flicker; hold a wrong colour/direction instead

sky_wrong.summary: The sky/sun/moon is wrong (sun at night, two dawns, wrong hour in a window, sky never meets lake).

clock_wrong.summary: A clock is wrong (backwards, 12:00, five minutes from the hour, disagrees with all others).

afterimage.summary: A dead screen keeps showing the last picture as a faint ghost.

sound_persist.summary: A sound continues after its source is gone (TV song, tank pump hum, echo too long).

sound_wrong.summary: Audio is wrong: detuned, doubled, a dropout, a whisper under room tone, a footstep with no foot.

warm_surface.summary: A surface reads as warm/alive: heat shimmer, soft breath-fog, a faint sound (dirt floor, pot, one bronze bird).
warm_surface.reduced_motion: static shimmer off, keep audio cue

particles_reverse.summary: Falling/flowing motion reverses for a moment (snow upward, ripples inward).

object_state.summary: A persistent object is in the wrong state (axe where you left it, calendar blank, candles already lit, pile larger).

material_drift.summary: A material changes slowly (chandeliers milkier, decay fresher, walls rounder in texture).

scale_move.summary: Reserved: things pulling closer, crowding in (treeline, silhouettes). Use move_unseen for the actual move.

instances.text: The 'sun' the Sweaty Man runs off into (story line s027): a hard daylight glow past the hedge while it is night.
Snow falls upward for a second, once, in peripheral vision.
After the TV dies, its last picture lingers on the glass.
The song continues faintly from the dead TV.
The couch family never blinks while the TV is lit.
The wall clock's second hand runs backward.
The front door is ajar when you did not open it.
The hall closet is deeper than the hall.
The fish tank pump keeps humming after the tank is gone.
Act 5: the kitchen is exactly right, which is the wrong thing (nothing out of place, no wear).
The right fork has no end; the left is the one in front.
The same hill repeats.
Every silhouette in the inn window faces the road; one is yours.
The road is slightly wider than the lane markings.
Mile markers count the wrong way.
The racoon's eyes hold too long and are not a racoon's.
The sun comes up in two places.
The facade has a different number of windows each look.
The treeline is closer each time you look.
Trees step closer when you do not look.
The winding path is longer going up than the clearing is wide.
Six steps up, a different count down.
The door behind you is a little taller each time.
The front door is too tall.
Chandelier crystals multiply.
The umbrella urn gains one umbrella each visit.
The foyer clock disagrees with every other clock.
One step too many going up than coming down.
The landing is longer going down.
A chandelier hangs where there was none.
The stair is taller than the tower; you climb longer than you descend.
The passage is longer than the gap between tower and dome.
No reflection of you in the dome glass.
Moonlight falls on you from the wrong side.
The dome room is wider each look.
The nests on the lantern are never twelve when counted.
The dirt floor is warm.
The light switch is on a different wall each time.
More pegs than people who ever lived here.
The clothes do not end; the corridor is longer each pass.
The left-right-left route is different each time.
The turns do not add up.
Linen on the line moves when you are not looking; more sheets than racks.
Every jar has the same label.
The vase shatter (story s062) echoes too long.
The doors are never the same count.
Chandeliers grow milkier along the walk.
The walls turn round and coarse toward the forest.
The clock says 12:00.
The calendar is blank.
Candles are lit before anyone lights them.
SCRIPTED story beat: Mary Sue's face changes to a woman's; Elsa's duller, longer (s082). Not driven by threshold.
The path is the hall; chandeliers hang between trees.
Sky and lake do not meet (story s088).
The moon is both above and in the water, and the water holds no other reflection.
Ripples travel inward; the bobber is the only motion.
The pillows are never seven when recounted (story: seven, with the seal).
The bed is slightly too wide.
The window shows the wrong hour.
Painted eyes follow you.
The 300,000 crowd in the Beatles painting is bigger each pass.
One painting is the same one repeated.
A painting from the west hall appears here.
The drop below is further than the foyer is tall.
The bed is larger every time.
Her things are half a size too small for her.
The back-stair door opens upstairs.
The clock is always five minutes from the hour.
More pans than hooks.
The table gains seats (canon: twenty; eighteen from Frank).
The family is a half-beat late in everything.
Frank is not where he sat.
The head chair is a little too far from the rest.
Doors on the east side are in a different order than before.
Every door looks the same; the open one is not always the same door.
The gallery is longer than the halls it flanks.
The statues face the doorway you stand in; the loon (Curt, 3 ft) moves first.
The bird statues all face one direction; the count never matches.
One bird is warm.
The suits of armour face the door you are in.
Their weapons change (sword, mace, bayonet, gun).
The gallery is longer than the building.
The axe is where you left it, which is wrong.
The woodpile is larger when you return.
The fire is brighter than its fuel.
The forest watches: tree gaps hold shapes that face the fire.
The decay is fresher than it should be.
The pot is warm before the fire is lit.
The wing is bigger than the facade.
The balls on the table have moved.
The dummy faces the door each time you return.
